description: This file defines the GroupByApiRootConvention class, which implements the IControllerModelConvention to modify the ControllerModel by setting its ApiExplorer group name based on a route attribute, facilitating API version grouping in ASP.NET Core.

classes.name: GroupByApiRootConvention
classes.description: Implements IControllerModelConvention to set the API explorer group name based on route attributes.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Sets the ApiExplorer group name for the controller based on its Route attribute.
